description: This file defines the DynamoDbClient class used in the AWS SDK for PHP to interact with Amazon DynamoDB. It includes method annotations for DynamoDB operations, manages retry logic, and provides session handling functionalities.

classes.name: DynamoDbClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon DynamoDB, extending the base AwsClient with additional configurations and convenience methods.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the default arguments for the client, including retry settings and API provider configuration.

methods.name: registerSessionHandler
methods.description: Creates and registers a DynamoDB session handler for managing PHP sessions.

methods.name: _applyRetryConfig
methods.description: Internal method to configure retry middleware based on the provided retry configuration.

methods.name: _applyApiProvider
methods.description: Internal method to apply the API provider configuration and wrap the parser with CRC32 validation.
